decomposition.rule: SE_cens ~= sqrt(SE_lo^2 - SE_point^2), assuming independent point and censored-bound components; SE_point comes from L2 (conditional mean over the L1-R point-resolved E0 PAs: complete PAs plus the rho_zero and rho_zero_before_node resolutions, experiments/pitchmdp/pitchmdp/policy_estimator.py:250-251,394-395) and SE_lo from the L1-R lower endpoint (all E0, a different denominator), so this is an illustrative approximation across different populations and normalizations, not an identified decomposition; the measured version is R5 f (common denominator, covariance reported)

se_cl.formula: over the games g = 1..G that have at least one PA in P: T_g = per-game sum of the per-PA values, n_g = PA count, N = sum_g n_g, Delta_bar = sum_g T_g / N; SE_cl^2 = (G / (G - 1)) * sum_g (T_g - n_g * Delta_bar)^2 / N^2 (centering by n_g * Delta_bar handles unequal game sizes; no seed)

R1 surrogate bias (X1), Rao-Blackwellized with common random numbers and no approximation, defined separately per surrogate with the world's exact conditional mean m(x,a,s) = E_W[r | x,a,s] = sum_e P_kappa(e | x,dp,a) * E_zeta[WE of the next state | s,e,a] (bin sums): gamma_b(s,a) = P_W(in play | s,a) * E_x[r_tilde_b(x,s) - m(x,a,s) | s,a] with r_tilde_b(x,s) = sum_e P_hat(e | x,dp) * terminal_values(s)[e] (A2-S0 table); gamma_a(s,a) = P_W(in play | s,a) * E_x[sum_e P_kappa(e | x,dp,a) * terminal_values(s)[e] - m(x,a,s) | s,a] (R1_a depends on the realized class e, so its surrogate term inside the x-expectation averages terminal_values over the world's class law P_kappa); along the S5 CRN truth rollouts (policy_truth, 12 per start, policy_semisynthetic.py:74-84) accumulate per R1 component G_pi = sum_t sum_a pi(a|s_t) * gamma(s_t,a), so E[G_c - G_r] = Delta_true(r_tilde) - Delta_true(r) by iterated expectation; b_hat_R1 = (1/n) sum_i mean_k (G_c - G_r)_ik, SE = sqrt(sum_i SE_i^2) / n with SE_i = SD_k / sqrt(12) and n = 147 starts; under V2 (exact rho) the DR is unbiased for the r_tilde value, so this equals the combined realized-WE bias of R1_x x R2_0 exactly; projection (planning arithmetic, not a measurement): SE <= B/2 corresponds to an equal per-start paired SD <= (B/2) * sqrt(12 * 147) = 42 * 6.3e-6 ~= 2.65e-4 (derived; the actual SD is unmeasured)

S2 deterministic invariant (registered check): the world's advancement model is the frozen C0 EmpiricalAdvancement that terminal_values uses (declared matching advancement model), so gamma_a = 0 identically whenever zeta = 0, including nonzero kappa; in the zeta = 0 X1 runs (kappa_p, 2*kappa_p, 5*kappa_p) |gamma_a| <= 1e-12 at every visited (s,a), otherwise a deterministic integrity failure (stop_rules.deterministic_integrity)

point_set.definition: E0 PAs whose baseline (R1_0 x R2_0, L1-R) paired delta bounds are equal (float ==)
point_set.non_point_under_a_pair: that pair has no P mean: its P statistics are invalid (fail-safe, counted); its L1-R endpoints stay defined (separate validity)
point_set.sn: the same P for SN: a P row with an unknown end is a point while its SN paired bounds coincide (full-sample normalisers and every replicate); a full-sample non-point P row (an undefined full-sample P mean) invalidates every SN P statistic of the pair, whatever the replicates give; a drawn non-point P row invalidates that replicate's P statistics
point_set.variant_bounds: for every variant (SN, finite lambda or M) a shared unknown end cancels algebraically when the transformed slopes are equal (bounds coincide exactly, no tolerance); the baseline keeps the registered policy_estimator formula
point_set.minimum: fewer than 50 P PAs: the P statistics of every pair (SN and DR alike) are invalid; the all-E0 endpoint intervals keep only the inherited E0 minimum
point_set.display_clipping: only public display values (probabilities, shares, KL) are clipped into their bounds when they lie within the display tolerance outside them; the display tolerance is the protected estimator's probability sum tolerance (1e-9: |sum(p) - 1| <= 1e-9 accepted, per-value excursions <= 1e-9 clipped at display), so a vector that estimator accepts never costs an attempt at display; farther outside is a deterministic integrity failure of the display; internal arithmetic (the placebo tau tuning and every statistic) uses raw values and is never clipped

precision.degenerate_se: SE = 0 (or a zero half-width) is INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS, except the registered exact S-2 gamma_a invariant at zeta = 0
precision.condition_ii: H(pair) <= 0.7 H(baseline) evaluated directly; a zero baseline or pair half-width is degenerate (INCONCLUSIVE, not a pass)
precision.invalid_repetition: an invalid repetition or replication in an acceptance-relevant run or cell makes that cell INCONCLUSIVE and the pair non-adoptable; records keep it JSON-safe (null value, invalid flag, count and reason)
precision.s5_degenerate: a zero-width or zero-SE S-5 shift interval is INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS
precision.r1b_table_failure: every m nonfinite in a TAB replication: the R1_b pairs are NOT_EVALUABLE, the R1_0 and R1_a pairs continue

window.rule: the whole command (argument parsing to the completion receipt) must end strictly before 06:30

guards.coverage: hang timer, RSS cap and free-memory guard from argument parsing to the final seal (preflight, data acquisition under the common heavy lock, computation, hashing, every manifest write and the seal; unblind and the manifest commands included); the hang timer stays armed through the completion receipt and is disarmed by the bounded cleanup
guards.publication: every receipt is published atomically: the verified manifest bytes (read by the bounded writer) plus the entry go to a staging file created exclusively under a name unique to the write (pid, counter, kind, stage, attempt) by the bounded writer, whose create, write, fsync and close are bounded by 10 s together (it owns its descriptor and never renames, so a timed-out writer never touches another receipt); for a completion receipt the final guard check runs (memory sample, the cleanup reserve left, then no pending interrupt or watchdog violation, re-checked immediately before the rename), then the atomic rename (os.replace) is the commit point: it runs synchronously in the command thread, never in a worker that could be abandoned, so the receipt is committed exactly when it returns (known in memory, no manifest read needed); guard interrupts are held as pending during a publication; any failure before the rename removes the staging file (bounded; a leftover is removed by the next writer), publishes no seal and records a non-citable ABORTED (ABORTED.json with the last 4000 characters of the traceback, and a stage_failure receipt); after the rename nothing aborts the stage: a directory-sync error is persisted as an append-only record (postcommit_errors.jsonl in the attempt directory, or beside the manifest; target selection and writing together in the bounded writer), and any failure of that diagnostic is reported by a bounded stderr write and the exit code after the cleanup; the committed receipt stands and a rerun stays refused; every bounded publication step waits at most min(10 s, the time left before the hard cap minus the cleanup share), the cleanup share being min(1.5 s, cleanup reserve / 2) = min(WATCHDOG_JOIN_SECONDS 1 s + 0.5 s, min(30 s, 2.5% of H) / 2); a post-commit step stopped by that hard deadline ends the command at once with a nonzero exit (HardDeadlineReached, exit 3; no further step runs and the committed receipt stands); the command-line entry writes its final report and flushes the standard streams within min(REPORT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS 1 s, the time left before the hard cap), then exits at once (os._exit): an argparse exit passes its code through (--help 0, a usage error 2), a failure exits 3 for a guard stop or else 1 with its message and the last 4000 characters of its traceback, and an incomplete report makes the exit nonzero

guard_numbers.io_cleanup_share: min(watchdog_join_seconds + io_cleanup_slack_seconds, cleanup reserve / 2) = min(1.5 s, min(30 s, H / 40) / 2)

guards.attempt_rule: one rule for seal consumption, status, retry accounting and the terminal decision: an attempt is aborted if a stage_failure names it or its directory carries ABORTED.json or ABORTED_UNRECORDED.json, committed if its seal was published, reconciled, or unfinished; an unfinished attempt (a crash before the rename) is reconciled into ABORTED_UNRECORDED (non-citable marker in its directory) so a new attempt can proceed
guards.memory_measurement: an unavailable, unparsable or timed-out free-memory measurement is a memory-guard stop (fail closed), never treated as enough memory
guards.memory_watchdog: a watchdog thread checks the RSS cap and free memory every 1 s through every code path (the protected estimator included) and interrupts the main thread on a violation
guards.finalization_reserve: work checkpoints stop at the hang guard minus min(120 s, 10%); hashing and the manifest run inside that reserve under the unchanged hard cap
guards.cleanup_reserve: the final check refuses to seal within the last min(30 s, 2.5%) of the hang guard; the rename and the cleanup (watchdog join bounded by 1 s, memory sampling bounded by 2 s, late signals consumed before the handlers are restored) fit in that reserve; an interrupt after the committed rename is reported after the cleanup, the seal stands
guards.manifest_commands: register-digest, record-review, reconcile-attempt and register-addendum run under the window, memory and hang guards (the A2-S4 hang guard)
guards.attempts: an attempt-start receipt is appended before the stage directory exists; at most two starts; a start without a receipt counts and needs a recorded reconciliation before the next start
guards.refusals_before_attempt: registry, digest, receipts, sources, destination, upstream seals, G-SMOKE, the smoke layout plan and the A2-S4 stage status refuse before the attempt-start

receipts.G-CODE: verdict PASS, or PASS_WITH_NOTES with notes closed; commit = the running code commit; config digest = the registered digest
receipts.G-REG: verdict PASS, or PASS_WITH_NOTES with notes closed; config digest = the registered digest

implementation.destination: a fresh directory directly under output_root; output_root disjoint (resolved real paths) from the repository, the main checkout (git common directory), the S6-dr-a5 stage directory, the processed frame directory, the split-aligned copy's directory and its identity manifest's directory, the artifact reports and cache directories, the raw root, the G0 bundle and WE directories and the directory of every ML-POLICY registered input
implementation.digest_manifest_location: the external digest manifest path is checked with the same disjointness rule (resolved real paths; outside every sealed input, the split-aligned copy's and its identity manifest's directories included, both checkouts and results/) before every manifest mutation, the manifest commands included

sealing.files: SHA256SUMS and manifest.json list every file of the stage directory except macOS AppleDouble sidecars; require_seal re-verifies the manifest.json bytes against the seal and every listed artifact
sealing.appledouble: a sidecar is a file named ._* that starts with the AppleDouble magic 00051607 (pitchmdp/matrix_policy_artifacts.is_appledouble; macOS writes them beside files on the exFAT output volume): never sealed or verified, so sidecars appearing before or after the seal (._SHA256SUMS and ._manifest.json included) change nothing; a ._* file without the magic is an ordinary artifact, sealed and verified

implementation.digest_manifest_writer: one writer at a time: a command holds an exclusive non-blocking fcntl lock on the manifest's sibling lock file from its location check to its last receipt (every append locks too); the chain and its tail digest are verified under the lock before each append; a second writer refuses
implementation.terminal_decision: A2-S4 may record FAILED_INTEGRITY as soon as a stage exhausted its attempts in a deterministic integrity failure; its unsealed descendants are recorded as BLOCKED and other unsealed stages as NOT_RUN
implementation.tab_descriptive_stop: a descriptive cell stopped by the work deadline (after every acceptance cell is sealed) is written as a NOT_RUN cell record and sealed with the stage
implementation.smoke_projection_ratio: rows of the processed row groups overlapping TRAIN (footer metadata, an upper bound) / rows of the smoke subset before the regular-season filter (labelled projection)
